blockingFindings.title: R1 blocking finding schema requirement is not covered
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 test only asserts requirementId type/minLength/enum on nonBlockingImprovements and only asserts enum on blockingFindings indirectly in the R5 test. It never verifies that blockingFindings items require a non-empty requirementId, nor that requirementId appears in the required-property list for either item schema.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local assertions that both blockingFindings.items and nonBlockingImprovements.items require requirementId and enforce non-empty known target-spec IDs.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 explicitly requires the prompt and JSON schema to require a non-empty requirementId on every blockingFindings and nonBlockingImprovements item. The current tests could pass while blocking findings omit requirementId or while requirementId is optional.

blockingFindings.title: R7 coverage artifact overstates bounded schema-failure coverage
blockingFindings.issue: The artifact marks R7 covered only by impl-review-resume.test.js, but that file covers the 41-item boundary and stopped-state resume path only. It does not cover bounded schema-failure exhaustion, which R7 explicitly includes.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Either add an R7-tagged spec-local assertion for bounded schema-failure exhaustion or update the coverage artifact/test tagging so R7 maps to an actual test that covers that requirement clause.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact contradicts the actual test files for a must requirement, and implementation could satisfy the resume test while leaving the R7 bounded-exhaustion clause untested.
